title: Pocketwire Savings Vault Interest Terms Schedule
content:
The terms below set, for each Pocketwire Savings Vault tier, the balance that earns interest on a given day, the day-count basis, the posting day, and how interest is treated while a vault is frozen and in the month a vault is closed.

## Schedule of interest terms

| | Pocketwire Vault Essential | Pocketwire Vault Select | Pocketwire Vault Preferred | Pocketwire Vault Premier | Pocketwire Vault Reserve | Pocketwire Vault Private |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Smallest end-of-day vault balance that earns interest for that day | $1.00 | $1.00 | $1.00 | $0.01 | $0.01 | $0.01 |
| Day-count basis of daily accrual | Actual days, 365-day year | Actual days, 365-day year | Actual days, 365-day year | Actual days, 365-day year | Actual days, 365-day year | Actual days, 365-day year |
| Interest posting day | Last calendar day of the month | Last calendar day of the month | Last calendar day of the month | Last calendar day of the month | Last calendar day of the month | Last calendar day of the month |
| Frozen vault keeps accruing interest | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Interest accrued in the month of closure paid at closure | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Explanatory notes

- **Smallest earning balance.** The figure is the lowest end-of-day balance of a vault that earns interest for that day. On Pocketwire Vault Essential, Select and Preferred a day ending at $1.00 earns interest and a day ending at $0.99 does not; on Pocketwire Vault Premier, Reserve and Private any day ending at $0.01 or more earns interest.
- **Actual days, 365-day year.** Interest accrues for each actual calendar day, and each day's accrual uses the annual rate divided by 365.
- **Posting day.** Interest accrued over a month is posted on the last calendar day of that month.
- **Frozen vaults.** On every tier the schedule shows Yes: a frozen vault keeps accruing interest.
- **Closure month.** Pocketwire Vault Essential shows No: interest accrued in the month a vault on that tier is closed is not paid at closure. The other five tiers show Yes: interest accrued in the month of closure is paid at closure.
